newsitem.title: UK: UK's Williams Lea in pact with Bowne of U.S.
newsitem.headline: UK's Williams Lea in pact with Bowne of U.S.

text.p: British research printing firm Williams Lea Group said on Tuesday it has formed a global partnership with U.S. financial printing group Bowne & Co Inc, beginning on December 1. As part of the deal, Bowne will acquire Williams Lea's financial printing interests, which currently account for about 15 percent of group turnover.
No shares will be exchanged in the deal, and Williams Lea will retain its independent position in the UK, the firm said in a statement. Financial terms were not disclosed.
The partnership, Bowne Williams Lea International, will offer in-house documentation and related information management services and will have offices in New York, London, and Asia.
Williams Lea estimated its revenues for 1996/97 would exceed 50 million stg.
